{
  "working_thesis": "Action and speech are the fundamental human activities through which unique personal identities are disclosed within the human condition of plurality and natality; because action is inherently unpredictable, irreversible, and boundless, it generates profound calamities for human affairs, which are traditionally remedied through the substitution of making for acting, but which are authentically redeemed from within action itself through the internal potentialities of forgiveness and promising.",
